findings.claim: MEDIUM — The documented display shift leaves the mating chain fixed in Y. High confidence in the missing dependencies; dynamic measurement reserved for root.

MEDIUM — R4 color faces use fixed XY apertures and fuse without clipping against the edited blank; WindowMargin or DisplayShiftY may therefore refill the edited opening. Magnitude requires native probing.

MEDIUM — check_revI.py compares legacy no-case normalization to Level although its contract is Solid; it also expects battery Z=2 instead of 1.4. The documented current harness and its receipt are stale.

recommendations: Confirm the documented CAD edits using isolated native probes, then repair shared parameter dependencies and current validation harnesses.
Retain unrouted PCB, integrated firmware, exact connector fit, retention, charging, BLE and power as unresolved product requirements.
Check the USB corridor against cases and broaden cap/screw coverage before claiming a collision; neither hypothesis was established in this static review.
